comment: Dr. Hayden is a very sweet man who just wants to share his passion for plants. He is clearly knowledgeable about this topic but the class is very boring and tedious for students who are not equally passionate. His lectures are dense and the labs are confusing and not intuitive. The exams were INSANE. I've never made so many flashcards in my life.

Dr. Hayden is a really nice man but his class is all lectures and honestly doesn't have much to do with biology. I would avoid taking his 199 if you want to get more of a basis. I ended up with an A but most in the class did not.

Overall Dr. Hayden is a very sweet professor who cares about his students. Each class is very lecture heavy, and he presents off of slideshows for the entire class. BE READY TO TAKE NOTES. Tests in this 199 class are extremely difficult if you are not good at memorization. Any niche fact on the slideshows is fair game for being assessed on exams.
Extremely thorough, made complex concepts easy to to understand, and engages questions with the same thoughtfulness. Also makes.himself readily available. Great teacher.

Easy on a weekly basis (stay full 3 hours for lab but no take home lab packets & 2 10Q worksheets). Passionate and knowledgeable teacher, but lectures the full time. Tests are 250 slides of detailed material (straight from lecture). Nice guy and final grade is just the flat average of 4 exams, 2 presentations (easy), 1 paper (easy), & HW (easy).

Very nice, very passionate about plants. Anything on his ppt's are fair game for tests, and the m/c sections is where ppl's grades go down. If you love botany/biology and are good at memorizing a lot of material, and can handle classes being all lectures, you'll love his class. Try to get papers/projects done early.

I took this class as an elective. I was so afraid because I am not good at science, but Dr. Hayden helps me a lot. Although his lecture is heavy, all the materials you need for tests are ready in the powerpoint that he gives to us. No reading book required, short homework, helpful outside class time. Definitely recommend him and he saved my grade!

Dr. Hayden is a great professor that is passionate and knowledgable about what he teaches. Tests cover a lot of material. Labs mostly graded for completion. I would recommend taking Professor Hayden's class to have a professor that really knows what he is talking about.

Dr. Hayden is a great professor for BIO199. While the tests are on very dense powerpoint they are not impossible and all powerpoint are always on Blackboard. There are homework's due every class but they are 10 questions and take about 20 minutes to complete, which help to raise your grades. Overall, great professor and would take again!

I took Hayden for Medical Botany and the class itself was interesting. 4 exams throughout the semester and HW was completion. We also had a few papers to write. He basically reads off of the powerpoint slides, which are SO lengthy. Anything is fair game on the exams which is a bit ridiculous since some of the material was never discussed.

Every lecture he has a powerpoint slide and reads off of it. There is never a variation, so it gets a little boring. He likes to make jokes no one understands and then he laughs about them to himself. There was three exams and a final . The exams only came from the powerpoint slides, any random fact on there was fair game.

Such a kind guy who loves what he teaches! Theres a lot of content to learn and study, but its interesting and he posts the lectures online which is really helpful. Must study hard for tests, but there are usually no surprises with what to expect. If you want to know more about plants definitely worth it to take the class.

Dr. Hayden was great; very passionate about his subject. He grades easily; his test ARE his PowerPoints; rarely homework; got a textbook but didnt use it in class-mostly for clarification. He is lecture heavy, but the subject kinda requires it to be. Boring IF subject doesnt interest you in the slightest. curves when class as whole needs. helpful

Class attendance is completely unnecessary. His tests are based off the powerpoints in class, which consist of like 200 slides of extremely detailed information. Take someone else for 199. He is incredibly boring and hard

This man is a walking encyclopedia when it comes to Botany. Lectures are ppts, which he makes available on Blackboard. Tons of information in each, fortunately, you're supposed to be able to understand and talk about it rather than repeat it word for word. Amazing in labs. Overall great guy but boring professor.

I took Bio of plants as a gen ed. I learned, but his powerpoints get dry and are hard to focus on. Tests are a little too picky and you ought to study more than you think is necessary. Labs are great, understandable, and he offers help if needed.

Hayden loves plants.  He knows everything about plants.  He will teach you EVERYTHING about plants, which, although overwhelming, turns out to be really interesting.  Tests are very long but fair.  Much more interesting in upper level class than he was in when he taught the intro bios. A little spacey when it comes to people.
Pretty boring class- all powerpoints, but the tests are fair multiple choice that always have 'funny' answers. Nice guy - loves his plants.
One of the worst teachers I've had at Richmond. He is never helpful and extremely vague yet his tests are rediculous and ask way to picky questions. Don't take any of his classes.
